messages.content: Hi, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent. Do you have a blood pressure reading handy to share today?
Yeah. 141 over 87. Took it about an hour ago.
Thanks for that — logging 141/87 now. Got it on file. Anything else going on, or are we good for this week?
Nah that's it. Pretty quiet out here.
Sounds good. I'll have your next check-in scheduled for the same time next week. Stay warm out there.

theme: routine weekly check-in, reading logged, nothing else
